operation_details.item: The user uses Gong for call analytics.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: How’s the client pipeline looking this Tuesday?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Pretty solid. I’m reviewing this week’s calls and tightening follow-up priorities around the accounts with the clearest revenue potential.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Are you using any call insights to guide those priorities?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes, I use Gong for call analytics. It helps me spot patterns in objections, next steps, and where the team can improve its discovery.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That sounds useful for coaching as well as account planning. How are you connecting those insights to your workflow?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I keep Salesforce as the CRM, use Outreach for sequence automation, and have all call data stored in the revenue operations hub so the team can work from the same view.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Please forget only that I use Gong for call analytics, while keeping the CRM, outreach, and revenue-ops details.
